scope: Frozen flattened whole-program inputs, old Canonical/Dense controls, current flat TS control and compiled A0 frontend. Parser/checker plus one historical C text emitter. Frontend instantiation/upload/typed-IR decoding included. Graph I/O, shipping CLI startup, formatter, model inference and generated-target execution excluded. Every fresh process preloads the common candidate SDK and its selected artifact; candidate artifact also preloaded for historical and TS controls. Per-sample preload records identify every Wasm component, hash and size. Artifact validation and Wasm module compilation are outside frontend/pipeline phases; fresh-child wall time includes process startup and preparation. No official source cutover or no-regression conclusion is implied.
protocol: Reuse the archived frontend experiment input corpus and rotated fresh-process protocol; one discarded warmup round and seven measured rounds. Every arm uses the historical baseline C text emitter, so frontend IR is compared through one fixed backend even when frontend artifact code generation changes. Every emitted C hash must match the baseline control. That control must match the frozen reference after the explicitly recorded compiler-version banner substitution. Compiled-backend mode requires the same A0 source closure/count, generic arena runtime hashes, libc/builtins and Clang/LLD versions; backend code generation, feature requirements and stack settings are separately recorded in the complete build manifests and are not claimed matched.

controlArtifact.scope: Candidate A0 source frontend built from shared compiler modules. Public TypeScript C backend bootstraps this artifact. No official source cutover or performance claim.

baselineTransportStackProof.method: All linked instructions decoded; constant balanced frames summed over an acyclic direct call graph. Linear-memory C stack only; traps terminate an invocation.

transportStackProof.method: All linked instructions decoded; constant balanced frames summed over an acyclic direct call graph. Linear-memory C stack only; traps terminate an invocation.

memoryMethod: Live frontend RSS/heap/external memory captured before emission. Initial peak/live RSS exposes any inherited launch or preload floor; maxRSS alone cannot establish small-cell frontend parity.
